# UsageMonitor 0.1.1
- Claude: the macOS Keychain prompt should no longer come back every time Claude Code refreshes its sign-in. The credential is now read the same way Claude Code writes it. - Ollama: enter your session and weekly reset times from ollama.com/settings under Settings → Providers → Ollama → Reset times. The card then shows when each limit resets, with the time-remaining shading. A passed session reset clears itself; the weekly one repeats every 7 days.
This is also the first update delivered through Check for Updates…. If it does not install cleanly, download it from https://github.com/jYannni/UsageMonitor-releases.
